timeline.event: Lost on Lake Superior with all 29 crew

tiers.everyday: The bell of the Edmund Fitzgerald, a ship lost on Lake Superior in 1975, was raised in 1995. It is a memorial to the 29 people who died.
tiers.student: The Great Lakes Shipwreck Historical Society records the loss on 10 November 1975 with all 29 crew and recovery of the 200 lb bronze bell on 4 July 1995; it is displayed at Whitefish Point.
